backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor for the Nature Glow e-commerce backend, defining types and logic for products, orders, user profiles, site settings, Stripe/Razorpay config, and WhatsApp button settings, with access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor state from an old schema (without WhatsApp button settings) to a new schema by injecting default WhatsApp button settings derived from existing site settings.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented frontend features (Hero, Featured Products, Benefits, Testimonials, etc.) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key behaviors of each component, page, hook, and style file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property color tokens for light and dark themes, including sidebar, chart, and semantic UI variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Nature Glow app, loading Playfair Display and Lato fonts from Google Fonts and the Razorpay checkout SDK, with a root div for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with all customer and admin routes, wraps customer pages in a layout with Navbar, Footer, CartDrawer, and FloatingWhatsApp, and protects admin routes with AdminAuthGuard.
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: A React section component that presents Ayurveda's philosophy, history, and the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) with scroll-triggered slide-in animations using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: A route guard component that redirects unauthenticated or non-admin users to the admin login page, showing a loading spinner while authentication and admin status are being verified.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar (desktop and mobile) containing navigation links and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: Admin UI widget that simulates AI image generation by selecting a curated Unsplash botanical image based on a text prompt, with a preview and a use-image callback.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: A modal dialog that displays full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and allows admins to update the fulfillment status via a dropdown select.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: A modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, image upload, AI image generation, and key-value specifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: A read-only modal that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and total order count.
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: A React section component displaying six product benefit cards (e.g., 100% Natural, Cruelty-Free) with icons and scroll-triggered fade-in animations via IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out cart drawer using a Sheet component that lists cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button that navigates to the checkout route.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: A homepage section that fetches and displays up to three featured products in a grid using React Query, with skeleton loading states and a link to the full shop.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation and tooltip that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat, using a backend-fetched number with a hardcoded fallback.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A site footer with brand info, social media icon buttons, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details, styled with a forest-green theme.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section for the Nature Glow landing page with animated entrance effects, botanical background image, headline, description, and CTA buttons linking to the shop.
Slide-in mobile navigation drawer with links to Home and Shop, plus an auth button for admin login/logout.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links, cart icon with item count badge, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying image, category, name, price, and status badges, with Add to Cart and Buy Now actions using Razorpay checkout.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible utility component that auto-seeds sample products into the backend when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Testimonials section rendering a grid of animated customer review cards with star ratings, quotes, and author info.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: An in-memory React context providing cart state (items, open/close) and operations (add, remove, update quantity, clear) using Product objects with bigint IDs.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: A sessionStorage-backed React context for cart state using string-based product IDs, providing add, remove, update, and clear operations along with cart open/close state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and persisting identity across page reloads via a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the application, exposing queries and mutations for products, orders, site settings, user profiles, shopping lists, admin management, and payment configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom hook that integrates the Razorpay payment gateway, loading the checkout modal with order details and navigating to success or failure pages based on payment outcome.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Lato), and defines CSS custom properties for both the customer storefront (Ayurvedic palette) and admin panel themes, including dark mode variants.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers wrapping the root App component.
Admin dashboard displaying revenue, order, product, and user stats via summary cards, a monthly revenue bar chart, a fulfillment-status pie chart, and a recent orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that authenticates via Internet Identity, attempts to claim or verify admin status on the canister, and redirects to the dashboard on success.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin page for viewing and managing customer orders, with filtering by payment/fulfillment status, search, sorting, stats summary cards, and an order detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin page for managing the product catalog, supporting search, status-based stats, add/edit via a form modal, and delete with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store name, contact email, announcement banner, Razorpay key, and WhatsApp number, with save actions and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page that lists registered users with search by name or principal, displays a summary table, and opens a detail modal on row click.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal options, and triggers a Razorpay checkout for the total order amount.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details and initiates a Stripe payment session, redirecting the user to Stripe's hosted checkout URL on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes the landing experience by rendering Hero, FeaturedProducts, SeedProducts, Benefits, Testimonials, and AboutAyurveda sections.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static payment failure page shown after an unsuccessful transaction, offering buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Static payment success page confirming order placement and providing links to continue shopping or return home.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that fetches a single product by ID, displays its image, description, and status, and supports add-to-cart and Razorpay buy-now flows.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop listing page with search, category, and status filters that queries all products and renders them as a filtered grid of ProductCard components.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting numbers as Indian Rupee currency strings and converting nanosecond bigint timestamps to human-readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Exports a static array of sample ProductInput objects (face packs and powders) used to seed the product catalog with demo data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the Ayurvedic skincare frontend, defining a custom brand color palette (forest green, sage, golden, cream, terracotta), typography (Lato/Playfair Display), botanical box shadows, and custom keyframe animations including fade-in-up and accordion transitions.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 3) describing the premium Ayurvedic skincare website's architecture, color palette, existing features, known issues, and required image assets for the frontend build.
